title: Electrothermal strip, current drive: thermal runaway (analytic)
description:
The strip of the voltage-drive example, now fed a fixed current through x_lo (current_density) and grounded at x_hi; a resistivity rising with T makes the Joule power grow with T, and no steady state exists above J_crit = (pi / L) sqrt(k sigma0 / beta).
Analytic: beta (T_max - T0) = sec(pi/2 J_ratio) - 1, diverging at J_ratio = 1; theta = [cos(m (x - L/2)) / cos(m L / 2) - 1] / beta with m = pi J_ratio / L.
Sweep tab: beta_dT_max and dT_max versus J_ratio (0.2..0.95) with their references, against dT_const_sigma, the rise without feedback.
Derived values tab: T_max, dT_max, beta_dT_max, T_probe and I_ground against their references (~1e-4 or below, growing toward J_ratio = 1).
Line profile tab: T_profile (the cosine profile).
Probes tab: T_centre gets one sample per fixed-point iteration; the Picard gain is J_ratio^2, so plain Picard (study anderson_depth 0) takes ~100+ iterations at 0.95; the Anderson-accelerated loop (anderson_depth 3) needs far fewer.
Set J_ratio = 1.05 (no sweep) and anderson_depth 0 to see the runaway: the temperature grows each iteration and the study stops with a 'did not converge' warning (accelerated, the loop would head for an unphysical negative-resistivity fixed point instead).

parameters.name: J_ratio
parameters.description: drive current density as a fraction of the runaway current J_crit (the sweep runs 0.2..0.95)

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: strip width along y (insulated faces: the problem is 1D in x)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (200 cells along the strip)

parameters.name: sigma0
parameters.description: DC conductivity at T0 in S/m (platinum-like)

parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: temperature coefficient of resistivity in 1/K: rho = rho0 (1 + beta (T - T0))

parameters.name: T0
parameters.description: temperature of both strip ends and reference temperature in K

parameters.name: J_crit
parameters.description: runaway current density in A/m^2 (~1.3e9 here)

parameters.name: J_drive
parameters.description: applied current density in A/m^2 (inward through x_lo)

parameters.name: m_c
parameters.description: wavenumber m of the cosine temperature profile in 1/m (m L = pi at runaway)

parameters.name: dT_ref
parameters.description: analytic peak rise T_max - T0 in K (far beyond any real film near J_crit: the point is the divergence)

parameters.name: x_probe
parameters.description: temperature probe x: the cell centre just right of the strip centre

parameters.name: T_probe_ref
parameters.description: analytic temperature at the probe in K
